parameters.name: DedicatedHostClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the dedicated host cluster.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the dedicated host cluster. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter. The name cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the dedicated host cluster. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the dedicated host cluster. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
